008357: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_address_of_place(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId element_type, IrSourceRange source)
008358: {
008359:     if (place.value >= builder->function->value_count || builder->function->values[place.value].category != IR_VALUE_PLACE ||
008360:         builder->function->values[place.value].canonical_type.value != element_type.value || c_ir_bit_field_from_place(builder, place))
008361:     {
008362:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
008363:     }
008364:     if (c_ir_value_contains_label_provenance(builder, place))
008365:     {
008366:         IrValueId root = place;
008367:         u64 offset = 0;
008368:         u64 size = 0;
008369:         bool exact = false;
008370:         if (!c_ir_label_place_location(builder, place, &root, &offset, &size, &exact))
008371:         {
008372:             builder->failure_message = S8("a label-containing object may not escape through an address-taking expression");
008373:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
008374:         }
008375:         IrType* root_type = root.value < builder->function->value_count ? c_ir_value_type(builder, builder->function->values + root.value) : 0;
008376:         if (root_type && (root_type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY || root_type->kind == IR_TYPE_STRUCT || root_type->kind == IR_TYPE_UNION))
008377:         {
008378:             builder->failure_message = S8("a label-containing aggregate may not escape through an address-taking expression");
008379:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
008380:         }
008381:         // A scalar label pointer may be passed by address as an ordinary C
008382:         // object, but the frontend cannot prove mutations through an escaped
008383:         // alias.  Forget the label identity before publishing the address so
008384:         // any later computed goto is rejected instead of dispatching through
008385:         // stale metadata.
008386:         c_ir_label_metadata_clear(builder, root);
008387:         IrValueLabelMetadata* root_entry = ir_value_label_metadata_ensure(builder->arena, builder->function, root);
008388:         if (root_entry)
008389:         {
008390:             root_entry->has_non_label_provenance = true;
008391:         }
008392:     }
008393:     IrTypeId pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, element_type);
008394:     IrValueId result = c_ir_add_result(builder, pointer_type);
008395:     builder->function->values[result.value].points_to_read_only = builder->function->values[place.value].is_read_only;
008396:     IrSourceRange instruction_source = source;
008397:     IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_ADDRESS_OF, pointer_type);
008398:     instruction.operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 1);
008399:     instruction.operands[0] = place;
008400:     instruction.operand_count = 1;
008401:     instruction.result = result;
008402:     IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, instruction_source);
008403:     builder->function->values[result.value].definition = id;
008404:     return result;
008405: }

008407: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_vla_flat_pointer(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, IrSourceRange source)
008408: {
008409:     CIrVlaValue shape = c_ir_vla_value(builder, value);
008410:     IrValueId result = value;
008411:     if (shape.counts && !shape.slot)
008412:     {
008413:         // Unevaluated type prediction may retain a pointer/array shell which
008414:         // concrete VLA lowering flattens. Normalize that shell at a consumer;
008415:         // the saved shape remains the authority for element size and stride.
008416:         IrTypeId pointer = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, shape.element_type);
008417:         result = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, pointer, source);
008418:         if (result.value != value.value)
008419:         {
008420:             c_ir_vla_value_set(builder, result, shape);
008421:         }
008422:     }
008423:     return result;
008424: }

008426: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_index_place(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId base, IrValueId index, IrSourceRange source)
008427: {
008428:     CIrVlaValue shape = c_ir_vla_value(builder, base);
008429:     CIrVlaValue reversed = c_ir_vla_value(builder, index);
008430:     if (!shape.counts && reversed.counts && !reversed.slot)
008431:     {
008432:         IrValueId swap = base;
008433:         base = index;
008434:         index = swap;
008435:         shape = reversed;
008436:     }
008437:     bool dynamic = shape.counts && !shape.slot;
008438:     u32 dimension = shape.dimension + (u32)shape.array_lvalue;
008439:     base = dynamic ? c_ir_vla_flat_pointer(builder, base, source) : base;
008440:     if (dynamic && index.value < builder->function->value_count)
008441:     {
008442:         IrType* index_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->function->values[index.value].canonical_type);
008443:         if (index_type && (index_type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || index_type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN))
008444:         {
008445:             index = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, index, builder->ptrdiff_type, source);
008446:             for (u32 suffix = dimension; suffix < shape.dimension_count; suffix += 1)
008447:             {
008448:                 IrValueId count = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, shape.counts[suffix], builder->ptrdiff_type, source);
008449:                 index = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, index, count, builder->ptrdiff_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_MULTIPLY, source);
008450:             }
008451:         }
008452:     }
008453:     IrValueId result = c_ir_emit_index_place_raw(builder, base, index, source);
008454:     if (dynamic && dimension < shape.dimension_count && result.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
008455:     {
008456:         IrTypeId type = builder->function->values[result.value].canonical_type;
008457:         result = c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, result, type, source);
008458:         shape.dimension = dimension;
008459:         shape.array_lvalue = true;
008460:         shape.rvalue = false;
008461:         c_ir_vla_value_set(builder, result, shape);
008462:     }
008463:     return result;
008464: }

008466: // Materialize a distinct pointer rvalue without reading the array object.
008467: // The witness is frontend shape, never the ADDRESS_OF opcode alone.
008468: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_vla_address(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, IrSourceRange source)
008469: {
008470:     CIrVlaValue shape = c_ir_vla_value(builder, value);
008471:     IrValueId result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
008472:     if (shape.counts && shape.array_lvalue && !shape.slot)
008473:     {
008474:         IrValueId place = c_ir_emit_dereference_place(builder, value, source);
008475:         if (place.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
008476:         {
008477:             IrTypeId type = builder->function->values[place.value].canonical_type;
008478:             result = c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, place, type, source);
008479:             shape.array_lvalue = false;
008480:             shape.rvalue = true;
008481:             c_ir_vla_value_set(builder, result, shape);
008482:         }
008483:     }
008484:     return result;
008485: }
